notes: New Fable threads spread across accounts by 5h headroom and live thread count instead of stacking on one account until its 5h window blows; the Fable window now moves on every response and a Fable-window 429 is charged to Fable, not Weekly; sign-outs from two refreshers racing on one token stop; every logged 429 names its account and model. Bumps aliax-core to d71cea3 (orderByReset takes load/cap with DEFAULT_THREAD_CAP=3 soft, headroom-bucket key after spend-first; parseUnifiedHeaders reads 7d_oi under scopedCapOf(model) and classify429 maps seven_day_overage_included to that window; one refresh lock in src/refresh.ts shared by the gateway and the usage poll, vault re-read before a refresh, never-older saves; a throttled 429 no longer reads as a dead token). temp-code: SessionRegistry.liveLoad(provider) counts running/watching/starting threads per account (sessions.ts) and feeds AccountsService via AccountsDeps.load (index.ts); chooseAccount takes the load, counts the pinned account one higher, and passes load and cap to every pickFromCache (accountRouting.ts, accounts.ts); handleFor spawns with a fresh pick so a burst of resumes spreads by the live load rather than each keeping its sticky account (the row already re-picked fresh for idle threads via refreshAccount); logLimit writes account and model and observeHooks labels the 7d_oi header with the model's cap (gatewayObserve.ts). Tests: accountRouting, accounts, sessions-limits (liveLoad, fresh spawn), gatewayObserve (scoped window, 429 log fields).
